entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sudarshan Faakir, better known by his takhallus Faakir, was an Indian Urdu poet and lyricist. His ghazals and nazms were sung by Begum Akhtar and Jagjit Singh. His son Manav Faakir is a Music Composer & lyricist.
